name: delete_plugin
description: Get the dashboard link to delete/uninstall a plugin the customer already has installed (see list_installed_plugins). Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to delete it -- never speculatively. This tool re-verifies plugin_id/name against the real installed list itself and returns an error if it isn't actually installed, but still pass the exact plugin_id/name from list_installed_plugins rather than guessing -- don't rely on this check in place of that. For security reasons, deletion happens on the web, not through this assistant -- same as buy_plugin/install_plugin -- this tool does not delete anything; it returns a `delete_url` for the customer to finish there themselves.

name.description: The plugin's exact display `name`, from list_installed_plugins -- used to build the customer-facing link text without a separate lookup.
